jobs.title: Pricing & Revenue Specialist - Hotel
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Pricing and Revenue Specialist to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about pricing and revenue management and skilled at analysing performance and identifying opportunities to drive growth and profitability, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job.

## The job in brief :

Job Title - Pricing and Revenue Specialist

Team - Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Revenue

Level - Professional

Contract - Permanent full-time (EUR 36 h/week)

## Requisiti e competenze

## What your impact will be

- Develop and implement market-leading pricing strategies that optimise growth and margin.
- Analyse performance and communicate updates on revenue and margin trends.
- Analyse performance to identify opportunities to drive trading margin by adapting our pricing strategy.
- Help develop pricing tools and capabilities, considering all revenue streams and operational costs.
- Create and deploy pricing tests to develop the optimal pricing strategy.
- Evaluate the impact of pricing strategies on conversion and customer acquisition.
- Analyse competitor pricing activities and industry innovations.

## Your expertise:

- Experience in pricing and revenue management.
- Good understanding of revenue components within the Hotel business.
- Strong analytical skills, including strong Excel skills.
- Analytical and strategic thinking.
- Strong communication skills, including verbal, written and face-to-face communication.
- Professional proficiency in English.
- A positive, can-do attitude.
- Exceptional attention to detail.
- At least 1 year of experience working in the Travel industry.

## Desirable

- Basic SQL knowledge.

## Cosa offriamo

## Perks of working with us : How we work together: An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together : Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content Other perks : 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws. Wish you were here? We do, too! Selection process steps* : HR interview (30 minutes) 1st interview (1 hour): soft skills + technical knowledge + curiosity about the role. 2nd interview (30min): final meeting with the Director Offer extended (*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview) Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

Eligibility criteria:

By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you are legally authorised to work in the country of employment and that you do not require visa sponsorship to obtain employment visa status.

At lastminute.com, we live for the holidays. We are the European Travel-Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. With technology, we turn spontaneous thoughts into meaningful experiences, helping people travel the world.

Stiamo cercando uno specialista di prezzi e entrate per unire il nostro team di circa 1.700 persone in tutto il mondo per aiutarci a alimentare il viaggio del viaggiatore per milioni di turisti. Se siete appassionati di gestione dei prezzi e dei ricavi e qualificati ad analizzare le prestazioni e identificare le opportunità per guidare la crescita e la redditività, continuare a leggere, come si potrebbe essere la soluzione perfetta per questo lavoro.

## Il lavoro in breve:

Titolo del lavoro - Pricing and Revenue Specialist

Squadra - Reporting al capo dei prezzi e delle entrate

Livello - Professional

Contratto - Tempo pieno permanente (EUR 36 h/settimana)

## Requisiti e competenze

## Quale sarà il tuo impatto

- Sviluppare e implementare strategie di prezzi leader di mercato che ottimizzano la crescita e il margine.
- Analizzare le prestazioni e comunicare gli aggiornamenti sulle tendenze dei ricavi e dei margini.
- Analizzare le prestazioni per identificare le opportunità di guidare il margine di trading adattando la nostra strategia dei prezzi.
- Aiuta a sviluppare strumenti e funzionalità di prezzi, considerando tutti i flussi di reddito e i costi operativi.
- Creare e distribuire test di prezzo per sviluppare la strategia di prezzi ottimale.
- Valutare l'impatto delle strategie di prezzi sulla conversione e l'acquisizione del cliente.
- Analizzare le attività di prezzi dei concorrenti e le innovazioni del settore.

## La tua esperienza:

- Esperienza nella gestione dei prezzi e dei ricavi.
- Buona comprensione dei componenti di fatturato all'interno del business dell'hotel.
- Forte capacità analitiche, tra cui forti competenze Excel.
- Il pensiero analitico e strategico.
- Forte capacità di comunicazione, tra cui comunicazione verbale, scritta e faccia a faccia.
- Competenza professionale in inglese.
- Un atteggiamento positivo.
- Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli.
- Almeno 1 anno di esperienza nel settore Viaggi.

## Desiderabile

- Conoscenze di base SQL.

## Cosa?

Percorsi di formazione professionale e manageriali, accesso a piattaforme e-learning come O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (a seconda del dipartimento), e alla nostra piattaforma interna che offre contenuti di formazione su misura Altri vantaggi: 2 giorni di ferie pagate all’anno per scopi di volontariato Eventi sociali occasionali per favorire connessioni tra colleghi sconti del settore di viaggi e flash esclusivo personale Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti attraverso i momenti significativi della vita con opzioni di congedo (ad esempio responsabilità genitoriali, matrimoni, lutti, trasferizioni, ecc.) in linea con le leggi locali. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für Preis- und Umsatzmanagement interessieren und die Leistung analysieren und Möglichkeiten für Wachstum und Rentabilität identifizieren können, lesen Sie weiter, da Sie möglicherweise perfekt zu diesem Job passen.

## Der Job in Kürze :

Berufsbezeichnung - Pricing and Revenue Specialist

Team - Reporting an den Head of Pricing and Revenue

Level - Professionell

Vertrag - Vollzeit (EUR 36 h/Woche)

## Requisiti e competenze

## Was deine Wirkung sein wird

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung marktführender Preisstrategien zur Optimierung von Wachstum und Marge.
- Analysieren Sie die Leistung und kommunizieren Sie Updates zu Umsatz- und Margentrends.
- Analysieren Sie die Performance, um Chancen zu identifizieren, die Handelsmarge zu steigern, indem Sie unsere Preisstrategie anpassen.
- Helfen Sie bei der Entwicklung von Preisinstrumenten und -funktionen unter Berücksichtigung aller Einnahmequellen und Betriebskosten.
- Erstellen und implementieren Sie Preistests, um die optimale Preisstrategie zu entwickeln.
- Bewerten Sie die Auswirkungen von Preisstrategien auf die Conversion und Kundengewinnung.
- Analysieren Sie Preisaktivitäten von Wettbewerbern und Brancheninnovationen.

## Ihre Expertise:

- Erfahrung im Pricing und Revenue Management.
- Gutes Verständnis der Umsatzkomponenten im Hotelgeschäft.
- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, einschließlich starker Excel-Fähigkeiten.
- Analytisches und strategisches Denken.
- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich verbaler, schriftlicher und persönlicher Kommunikation.
- Professionelle Kenntnisse in Englisch.
- Eine positive, can-do Einstellung.
- Außergewöhnliche Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail.
- Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Reisebranche.

- Grundlegende SQL Kenntnisse.

Titre de l'emploi - Spécialiste de la tarification et des recettes

Niveau professionnel

JOB DESCRIPTION

## We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about designing & building AI solutions, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job. The job in brief: Job Title - AI Automation Engineer Working model - hybrid from Switzerland Team - you will join the Automation Engineering team within the Automation department. Level - Professional Location - Chiasso, Switzerland (only for hybrid positions) Contract - Permanent - full-time (EUR 36 h/week) What your impact will be: Build and scale n8n automation workflows. Design, build, and maintain production-grade workflows on our self-hosted n8n Enterprise platform (AWS EKS), supporting business units across the company and helping grow our Citizen Developer / self-service automation program. Design and build custom AI solutions. Develop applications and tools that use AI to support key business processes. These solutions will be tailored to specific needs across different departments. Connect AI tools with our systems. Integrate external AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude) with our existing tools using APIs, low-code platforms like n8n, and custom connectors. Contribute to our governed knowledge layer. Support and extend our Company Context / Universal RAG Knowledge Base, including document ingestion pipelines, retrieval quality, and access governance. Work with natural language processing (NLP). Create tools for analyzing conversations, automating emails, and generating insights from customer interactions. Build generative AI solutions. Use generative AI to automate tasks like content creation and communication personalization. Maintain and improve systems. Update code, monitor system performance, and retrain models regularly to ensure everything runs smoothly. Collaborate with tech teams. Work closely with data engineers, DevOps, and other developers to make sure AI tools are scalable and reliable. What You Might Build: n8n workflows automating cross-department processes NLP-based systems that analyze calls and emails RAG-powered assistants and chatbots grounded in our Company Context knowledge base Virtual assistants and chatbots to support internal teams Recommendation engines that guide real-time sales or support actions Automated tools to generate personalized content Dashboards and reporting tools that surface AI-generated insights Your expertise: 3+ years of hands-on AI development: You’ve built and shipped AI solutions that led to real business impact—whether that’s increased revenue, reduced cost, or improved customer satisfaction (NPS). Fast, practical builder: You move quickly from idea to working prototype, and improve as you go. You aim for results, not perfection. End-to-end problem solver: You take ownership from idea to deployment—writing documentation only when needed, and focusing on what works. Strong technical troubleshooting: You can quickly find the cause of technical issues using logs, dev tools, or pattern matching. Security-aware mindset: You understand authentication, authorization scopes, and safe handling of credentials. Communicator and storyteller: You present your ideas clearly, show live demos with confidence, and help business teams understand the value of your work. Your Skills and Tools Automation Platforms: Hands-on experience with n8n (or similar low-code platforms such as Make, Zapier), including self-hosted/enterprise deployments. Languages: Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript. AI/ML Development: Experience with LLMs (e.g. Claude, Gemini, OpenAI), prompt engineering, and building agentic workflows; familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. RAG & Knowledge Systems: Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and document ingestion pipelines. Data & APIs: Strong understanding of APIs, cloud-based infrastructure, and microservices architecture. Software Practices: Familiar with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and the full software development lifecycle. Cloud & Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), container tools (Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures. We are looking for a Global Payroll & HR Systems Manager to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. The role will focus on leading our global payroll operations, optimizing HR systems, and ensuring compliance across multiple geographies. If you have a strong background in global payroll management, HRIS implementation, and systems optimization, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job.

## The job in brief:

Job Title - Global Payroll & HR Systems Manager

Working model - hybrid from Switzerland

Team - you will join the People Operations team

Level - Manager, reporting to Head of Payroll

Location - Chiasso, Switzerland

Contract - Permanent - full-time (EUR 36 h/week)

## What your impact will be:

- Lead end-to-end global payroll operations for all countries, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with local regulations.
- Own and manage all HR Systems (HRIS/HCM) globally, acting as the primary system administrator and continuous improvement driver.
- Lead global HRIS implementation and upgrade projects, ensuring seamless integration with other internal systems (e.g., Finance).
- Ensure global payroll and HR systems compliance and security protocols are met.
- Manage relationships with external payroll providers and HRIS vendors worldwide.
- Develop and maintain global reporting metrics on payroll, HR data, and systems performance for senior leadership.
- Provide expert guidance on best practices for payroll and HR systems configuration and data integrity.

## Your expertise:

- Proven (at least 7 years) experience in Global Payroll management and HR Systems administration (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle).
- Deep knowledge of complex multi-country payroll processes and compliance requirements.
- Strong experience in leading HRIS implementation, integration, and optimization projects.
- Demonstrated ability to embrace change and challenge the status quo to improve operational efficiency.
- Strong ownership of the global HR Systems perimeter, with the ability to manage priorities and work autonomously.
- Excellent communication skills in English is essential. Any other additional language will be considered a plus.

## Desirable:

- Experience in a travel or tech company environment.
- Exposure to and/or experience with People Operations & Administration in any additional European and extra-European countries is a plus.
